RESOLVED: Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the denial of your MRI claim (CLM-550193). 

"Prior authorization not on file" means that the specific procedure (the MRI) required approval from Meridian Health Plan before it was performed, and we did not receive a request for that approval from your provider.

You do have the right to appeal this decision. According to our policy (KB-2207), you have 180 days from the date of your denial notice to file a first-level appeal. Additionally, your doctor can submit a "retrospective authorization" request, which includes clinical documentation to show why the MRI was medically necessary for your migraines. 

I have attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this message. Once you or your provider submit the necessary documentation, we will process your appeal within 30 calendar days. Please let us know if you need any further assistance.
